title: Prom/Grafana + OTLP modularization sprint notes (VPC/on-prem observability)
content:
Purpose:
Sprint notes / working plan for breaking observability infra into small, reusable Terraform modules for VPC/on-prem private deployments. Focus areas: Prometheus (server + remote-write), Grafana (dashboards & provisioning), OTEL collectors (k8s DaemonSet / gateway), and log shipping (fluent-bit -> kafka/s3/customer ELK). This doc is intentionally rough — checklist + design decisions + upgrade/canary plan + open questions.

Scope:
- Target environments: customer VPCs (managed Private) and on-prem air-gapped bundles.
- Deliver modular TF that can be composed for both small-edge clusters and large private clusters.
- Preserve current operational SLOs for alerting/metrics, add safer upgrade path for OTEL Collector versions.

Constraints / non-goals:
- We are not changing long-term storage tech in this sprint (still Cortex/Thanos for hosted-ish long-term). If customer wants a different backend, module will expose remote_write/endpoint variables.
- No changes to Grafana dashboards content (only provisioning/style).

High-level module boundary proposals (small, composable):
1) prometheus-core: manages StatefulSet/Deployment for Prometheus server, configmap for prometheus.yml, rule files mounting. Exposes endpoints for remote_write, alertmanager config, scrape relabel rules.
2) prometheus-exporters: node-exporter, kube-state-metrics, windows_exporter wrappers. Optional per-cluster toggles.
3) prometheus-remote: remote_write adapter + TLS/credentials handling. Template for Cortex/Thanos, also supports pushgateway.
4) grafana-provisioning: provisioning files, datasource configs, dashboard provisioning, playlist and org setup. Supports local provisioning (file-based) or remote provisioning via API.
5) otel-collector: k8s DaemonSet + gateway Deployment module. Handles receiver config, processors (batch/attributes/k8sattributes), exporters (OTLP/Jaeger/OTLP-HTTP). Versioned helm-like values exposed as variables.
6) logship-core: fluent-bit/fluentd helm wrapper, central Kafka output or direct S3/ELK with auth configs.
7) observability-bootstrap: higher-level composition module that wires above modules, sets common labels, secrets references (KMS/HSM paths), and generates TLS certs (optionally present).

Interfaces and expectations:
- Each module must be consumable as a single terraform module block with minimal required variables: namespace, cluster_id, environment_tag, monitoring_retention_days.
- Secrets should be provided as external secret objects (sealed-secrets/k8s secret manager). The module must not create plaintext secrets.
- Modules should accept an optional prometheus_scrape_config overlay (YAML string) for site-specific tweaks.

Terraform notes / patterns to enforce:
- Use registry-style versioning and explicit changelog in module root.
- Keep modules small: aim for ~1 resource group per module to make partial upgrades safer.
- Avoid dynamic JSON templates in TF; prefer files rendered via templatefile() and supplied to k8s manifests.
- Use a dedicated state per module (per-cluster). Do not put monitoring modules in the same state as app infra to reduce blast radius.
- Provide examples in root examples/ for: minimal-edge-cluster, full-private-cluster (with Cortex remote_write), and air-gapped deploy (chart bundle + offline artifacts).

OTEL consumer compatibility and upgrade plan:
- Version pin collector images in module variables (default to latest stable at time of release).
- Provide a canary rollout boolean: when true, deploy collector-gateway with 10% of traffic (via k8s Service + weighted ingress or by annotating select namespaces) to validate exporters.
- Rollback plan: keep previous collector image available and implement a simple k8s patch script in ops-scripts/ that flips image and restarts pods. Documented in module README.

Canary and rollout matrix (minimal):
- Canary stage 1: Deploy collector-gateway only; no schema changes. Smoke test: metrics flow to remote_write, sample traces in Jaeger/Zipkin UI.
- Canary stage 2: Deploy collector as DaemonSet to 10% of nodes (nodeSelect label); validate resource usage and exporter success.
- Full rollout: replace image across all collector DaemonSets. Monitor for OOMs or exporter errors for 30 minutes before marking success.

Testing / validation checklist (pre-merge + post-deploy):
- terraform plan shows no unexpected resource diffs for example clusters.
- Prometheus config lint (promtool check config) before applying.
- OTEL Collector config lint (otelcol-contrib validator / run in local container).
- Automated smoke tests: curl metrics endpoint -> remote_write counters increment; produce a trace -> trace shows in UI.
- Log shipping test: generate test log on node -> observe in kafka topic or S3 location.

Migration checklist for existing private clusters (lift-and-shift):
1) Inventory current setup: prometheus version, exporters, grafana version, collector presence, log agent config. (Ticket ENGOBS-4123)
2) Deploy modular stack side-by-side in a new namespace (observability-staging) with remote_write pointed at a test target.
3) Reconfigure a small subset of scrapes to the new Prom server (use serviceMonitor relabelling or k8s annotations) to avoid collision.
4) Validate alerting paths and dashboard panels (compare numbers/series).
5) Cutover: update ingress/service records to new prometheus endpoint. Keep old server alive for 48 hours read-only.
6) Decommission old statefulset once retention/heartbeat and data parity confirmed.

Operational runbook snippets (to include in module README):
- How to rotate TLS certs for remote_write endpoints: steps + required secrets + restart hints.
- Common failure modes: exporter crashloop due to permission denies, collector exporter auth failures, grafana provisioning 409 on startup. Quick triage commands.

Performance and capacity notes:
- Default retention for edge clusters: 7 days, larger private clusters: 30 days. Expose retention as module var.
- Memory sizing: Prom server heap + TSDB: recommend 2x memory headroom for +1M series. Provide basic calculator link in README.

Open questions / TODOs:
- How strictly do we require remote_write TLS termination inside customer VPC vs. via an SDR gateway? (security review needed)
- Do we provide a managed Thanos sidecar option in module or leave as remote_write to customer-provided endpoint?
- Offline artifact distribution for air-gapped: build pipeline to produce image bundle and helm chart tar.gz (assign to release-engineering).
- Decide on default logging sink for new private deployments: Kafka vs direct S3. (comment from CS: many customers prefer S3)

Next actions (owners):
- Create prototype modules for prometheus-core + otel-collector (Jonah Kim) — target PR by 2024-10-18.
- Example compose for minimal edge and full private (Elena) — include tfvars and smoke-test scripts.
- Write module README templates with runbook snippets (Maya).
- Security review session on remote_write TLS and secrets (Priya) — schedule calendar invite.

Notes to self / rough entries:
- Keep alertmanager config out of prometheus-core module by default; provide optional attach module.
- Use k8s job to migrate recording rules from old clusters: script lives in ops-scripts/migrate-recording-rules.sh.
- Add telemetry hooks for module usage metrics (anonymous) so we can understand adoption.

Appendix: example minimal prometheus-core variables (for README)
- namespace = "observability"
- retention = "7d"
- storage_class = "fast-ssd"
- remote_write_enabled = false
- prometheus_image = "quay.io/prometheus/prometheus:v2.45.0"

Keep this doc live; convert to a more formal design doc after first prototype PR merges.
